title: Factors Affecting Outcome of Vestibular Rehabilitation
brief_summary: This is an observational longitudinal study to investigate if negative illness perceptions predict less improvement in dizziness handicap following vestibular rehabilitation. Consecutive patients (n=260) who enter the vestibular rehabilitation programme at Guy's Hospital, London will be included. Questionnaires will be conducted immediately before, and after their final treatment. The main outcome will be the Dizziness Handicap Inventory after rehabilitation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* are aged above 18 years old and are enrolled onto the vestibular rehabilitation programme due to chronic dizziness

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients will be excluded if they have evidence of central nervous system disorders or cannot speak English.
study_population: Patients with dizziness and balance disorders.
